close_reason: Won't fix: P3-opinion-only stylistic observation. The chat-client's top-level session.rs, sse.rs, ws.rs modules reflect that JMAP Chat has a genuinely different push-transport surface (WebSocket + SSE) than the other extension clients. Some asymmetry is expected; making chat-client look like the other 6 clients would either hide the WS/SSE surface or rename it confusingly. Per AGENTS.md convergence rule, P3/opinion is at bikeshedding threshold.
description:
crate-jmap-chat-client has top-level src/{session.rs, sse.rs, ws.rs, types.rs, utils.rs} alongside the standard `methods/` directory. All 6 other extension client crates put everything in `methods/` and have only lib.rs at the top.

Some divergence is justified (Chat has WebSocket and SSE-specific types other extension clients don't), but `types.rs` and `utils.rs` at the top level look ad-hoc.

Marked opinion. The chat crate's push transport is genuinely a different surface from the other extension clients, so some asymmetry is expected. Just want to flag it for review.

If the user wants symmetry: move chat-only client-side types under methods/ or rename types.rs → client_types.rs to make the role clearer.
title: P3: jmap-chat-client diverges from peer client crates' module layout
